title: Expand driver dashboard to full operational cockpit + add dedicated settings page
body:
This PR closes the driver-dashboard feature gaps by turning `driver-dashboard.html` into a complete driver workflow surface and introducing a dedicated settings page. It adds missing operational controls, ride context, performance visibility, compliance tracking, and support entry points using API-backed data with mock fallbacks where needed. - **Dashboard workflow controls** - Added online/offline availability toggle wired to `POST /api/drivers/availability` - Kept CSP-safe behavior (no inline handlers/scripts) while expanding interactive UI - Added settings entry in header (`/driver-settings.html`) - **Ride intelligence and dispatch context** - Added **real-time map panel** (driver marker + nearby request markers) - Added **ride history** table for completed rides (pickup, dropoff, fare, duration, passenger rating) - Added **ride details modal** on accept with passenger + trip/fare metadata - Added **Google Maps navigation actions** for pickup/dropoff directions - **Driver performance and earnings visibility** - Added **performance stats** block: - acceptance rate - completion rate - cancellation rate - average rating trend - Preserved existing earnings block and integrated refresh on ride actions - **Compliance and support operations** - Added **document/license management** section (license/insurance/registration uploads + expiry-state tracking) - Added **support/help section** with chat-style inquiry flow + contact channels - **New settings surface** - Added `public/driver-settings.html` and `public/driver-settings.js` - Includes editable sections for: - profile - payout/payment method - vehicle information - emergency contact - Persisted settings in local storage with stricter field validation (e.g., account last-4 format) - **Test coverage updates** - Extended static route assertions for enhanced driver dashboard content - Added route-level coverage for `/driver-settings.html` and CSP-safe script usage ```html Settings ```
Original prompt Enhance the driver dashboard (driver-dashboard.html) with the following missing features: 1. **Toggle Availability** - Add button to switch between online/offline status so drivers can accept rides 2. **Ride History** - Add section showing past completed rides with details (pickup location, dropoff location, fare amount, duration, passenger rating) 3. **Real-time Map** - Integrate map display showing driver's current location and nearby available ride requests 4. **Ride Details Modal** - When driver accepts a ride, show modal with passenger info, pickup/dropoff address, estimated fare, passenger rating 5. **Navigation/Directions** - Add button to open directions in Google Maps for pickup and dropoff locations 6. **Performance Stats** - Display driver metrics including acceptance rate, completion rate, cancellation rate, average rating trend 7. **Document/License Management** - Add section to upload and manage driver's license, insurance, vehicle registration with expiry date tracking 8. **Support/Help Section** - Add chat support or contact support form for driver inquiries 9. **Settings Page** - Create settings page to edit profile, payment method, vehicle information, emergency contact Update driver-dashboard.html and create any necessary supporting files (CSS, JS, HTML modals) to implement all these features. Use mock data for testing.
